intent: Implement the attached Esteban GEO Capture 20 build brief completely in this isolated worktree. Preserve existing work, use only source-backed facts, create no generic location routes, and leave permission/external-outreach actions as explicit private preparation. Add focused tests. Run page-date updates where content changes. Do not publish, submit a real form, email anyone, or modify external profiles.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: This is a factual and measurement repair to existing answer-first routes and contact controls. It preserves Esteban's established visual system and uses small, accessible choice controls rather than introducing a new composition or generic landing-page pattern.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Fuente: «No emojis los odio es una regla solo se usan cuando explícitamente los pido». También rechazó los emojis del navegador superior antes de esta corrección.
visual_evidence.comparison: The supplied phone capture is the current Fort Lauderdale Reels route. The implementation must keep its established editorial surface while making the source-backed buyer decision and exact contact action legible without overlay clutter, a second visual world, or optional text that disappears from server HTML.

brief.visitor: A South Florida or remote buyer who needs Reels editing, short-form video, event delivery choices, or a clear next step after an AI/search recommendation.
brief.promise: Existing service and guide routes answer the decision immediately, preserve evidence limits, and make the next contact step measurable without claiming that a citation caused a lead.
brief.primary_action: Choose a factual discovery source and project-delivery preference where relevant, then start the existing contact brief.
brief.friction: Current citations and query visibility do not identify which engine or buyer question produced an inquiry; high positions with zero clicks also suggest unclear packaging rather than a need for more URLs.

kpi.outcome: qualified inquiries with a persisted discovery source
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: geo snapshot records lead outcomes as unmeasured on 2026-11-22
kpi.evidence: pnpm geo:snapshot:status plus latest successful citation receipt
kpi.readout: compare source-tagged qualified inquiries at T+7, T+28, and T+56
kpi.decision_rule: retain only elements that preserve factual accuracy and produce attributable qualified-inquiry evidence without degrading completion

concept.idea: A compact decision path that turns an anonymous AI recommendation into a stated source and a useful project choice.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban's existing site is editorial, Spanish-first, and human; the repair adds clarity, not another generic location-sales layer.
concept.interaction: A familiar small choice control records discovery source and, for event work, delivery preference before the existing brief path.
concept.visible_response: The selected option remains visibly selected and the visitor sees the exact information that will accompany the brief.
concept.direct_path: A ready buyer can use the existing contact route without reading optional detail.
concept.alternatives: Do not add a chatbot, a large new hero, a generic city page, or a hidden JavaScript-only explanation.

story.opening: State who the existing route helps and what the person can do next.
story.action: Choose the relevant source or delivery preference only when it makes the brief clearer.
story.consequence: The selection is shown as part of the project brief and is persisted for an outcome read.
story.next_step: Continue to the current contact/quote path.

content.visible: Short answer-first service facts, a specific action, and simple labels for source and event delivery choices.
content.optional_html: Native server-rendered details or FAQs hold only factual scope and preparation depth.
content.linked_depth: Existing service, event, price, caption, and contact routes provide deeper reading; no new generic location URL is created.

references.borrow: Existing Esteban service-page shared Rail/common conventions and current phone hierarchy.
references.avoid: New decorative interface chrome, emoji, generic city-page repetition, and any UI that hides citable text behind client-only state.

components.reuse: Existing contact, analytics, service-depth, FAQ/details, and shared Rail/common components after manifest inspection.
components.local_reason: Only a small factual source/delivery chooser may be local if no existing shared primitive fits its persisted contact semantics.

verification.rendered_states: Inspect 375x667, 390x844, and desktop on affected service, guide, event, and contact states; selected and unselected controls remain readable and do not block the primary action.
verification.motion: No new motion is required; any existing motion must not gate text or interaction and reduced motion remains usable.
verification.accessibility_performance: Keyboard controls, labels, touch target spacing, contrast, and no client-only answer text; run project lint/typecheck/build and relevant tests.
verification.raw_html: Curl built or deployed HTML to confirm answer-first facts and native details are served from the first response.
verification.conversion_boundary: Use an authorized non-delivery test route or fixture to verify persistence and analytics payload shape; never submit a real customer form.

reviewers.craft: Antigravity reviews rendered affected states after deterministic gates.
reviewers.behavior: cto-qa-lead verifies payload persistence, analytics contract, raw HTML, and accessibility states.
reviewers.outcome: cto-growth-lead reads source-tagged qualified-inquiry evidence at T+7, T+28, and T+56.

learning.metric: qualified inquiry submissions with a persisted discovery source
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: source-tagged qualified inquiries are not currently measured
learning.hypothesis: Making discovery source and delivery choice explicit on the existing contact journey will create attributable inquiry evidence while clearer answer-first routes preserve the existing citation wedge.
learning.decision_rule: Keep a change only if it retains factual accuracy and creates or improves comparable source-tagged qualified-inquiry evidence without a completion-quality regression.
learning.registration_condition: Register the exact event and source field before release, then record the first comparable post-release read.
